name: cc
title: C and C++ (zig cc), CMake, Ninja
description: cc, c++, gcc, g++, clang, clang++, ar and ranlib as zig cc (Clang with Zig's own libc headers, libc++ and linker: programs are built against the glibc of the sandbox they are built in, or static with -target x86_64-linux-musl), CMake 4.4.4 and Ninja 1.13.2 (CMake's generator here: there is no make). It is Clang: no GNU binutils (nm, objdump), libc++ instead of libstdc++.
license: MIT AND Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception AND BSD-3-Clause AND Apache-2.0

files.hello.c:
#include <stdio.h>
int main(void) { puts("hello from c"); return 0; }

notes: The compiler is the toolchain zig (required: attached with it); this tree holds the wrappers, Kitware's CMake (cmake-4.4.4-SHA-256.txt) and Ninja's release binary (GitHub's digest), which needs libstdc++ and libgcc_s of the system.
